Time zone overlap matters more than the hourly rate. Our team works from Kerala, India and plans shifts around your working day. The free planner shows the overlap for your city, with daylight saving handled.

https://myremoteva.com/time-zones?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tz1-zones

If you have never delegated before, test with real work. The $1 plan adds one hour of VA work to your account every month for new registrations. Pick one small repeat task and judge the result. Prices are in US dollars.

https://myremoteva.com/pricing?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tr1-trial

Enter your hours per month and the calculator shows the cheapest plan across pay-as-you-go, blocks, quarterly packs and the dedicated plans. It works without signing up.

https://myremoteva.com/cost-calculator?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ca1-calc

The cheapest hourly rate is not the cheapest bill. Count rework, training and cover.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/cheap-virtual-assistant-services?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ch1-cheap

Listings, orders and customer messages follow written rules. Hand off the repeat parts, keep the decisions.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/ecommerce-virtual-assistant-checklist?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ec1-store

9 am in Toronto is 7:30 pm in Kerala in January. Evening shifts give a good overlap with Canadian business hours.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/hire-a-virtual-assistant-in-canada?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ca2-canada

Client reports are the most common thing that eats an agency's Friday. The numbers live in five tools and the layout never changes.

That is a good job to hand off: an assistant pulls the numbers into your template, you review and send. Start with one client for one month and see how many hours come back.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-for-marketing-agencies?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ag1-reports
